headline: Parking fees and a parking fund, no-parking areas, a vacant building and graffiti ordinance, and the pension plan.
summary: Other items include the legislative advocacy agenda, the Hubbard Park lights, and the library's five-year strategic plan. Consent items cover the Code of Conduct for 180 Market Street and the August financial reports.
items: Consent agenda: accept Garden Street, Foulsham Hollow Road, and Tilley Drive right-of-way infrastructure, with a stormwater maintenance agreement for Garden Street
Consent agenda: approve Resolution #2026-17 creating a Parking Fund
Consent agenda: approve Resolution #2026-18 to adjust parking ticket fees
Consent agenda: approve the Code of Conduct for 180 Market Street
Consent agenda: reappoint Tim Barritt and Laurie Smith to the Chittenden County Communications Union District for two years
Consider Resolution #2026-19 designating no-parking areas on streets (7:00-7:15 pm)
Library Board of Trustees presentation on the 5-year Strategic Plan (7:15-7:35 pm)
Actuarial update on the South Burlington Pension Plan and changes to valuation assumptions and methods (7:35-8:05 pm)
Discuss and possibly approve council priorities for the 2027-2028 legislative advocacy agenda (8:05-8:50 pm)
Discuss goals for a vacant building and graffiti ordinance (8:50-9:05 pm)
Discuss standardized communication to residents who contact the City Council and staff (9:05-9:20 pm)
Discuss wildlife-friendly amber bulbs and hours of operation for the lights at Hubbard Park (9:20-9:35 pm)
Discuss process and reporting improvements for high-value projects (9:35-9:50 pm)
Preview December 7, 2026 topics: FY28 budget, Land Development Regulations (warn a public hearing for January 4, 2027), and the Parks & Open Space Master Plan (9:50-9:55 pm)
Executive session on labor relations with the South Burlington Career Firefighters' Association, under 1 V.S.A. 313(a)(1)(B)
Executive session on contracts related to possible regional service provision, under 1 V.S.A. 313(a)(1)(A)

Review the significant agenda topics below for the Council’s December 7, 2026 Council 
Meeting: (9:50-9:55 pm)
l FY28 Budget:  The City Manager will present the proposed FY28 Budget 
l Land Development Regulations:  Tier 1A process updates (including Rare, 
Threatened, and Endangered Species standards) and technical corrections. 
Additionally updates to the bedrock standards.  Warn a Public Hearing for January 
4, 2027.  
l Receive the Parks & Open Space Master Plan
Other Business (9:55-10:05 pm)

of discussing labor relations agreements with employees and specifically the South 
Burlington Career Firefighters' Association

of discussing contracts and specifically contracts related to possible regional service 
provision

Jessie Baker
City Manager
